ios.desc:
Introducing UPic —the app that finally helps you clean up your camera roll, and yep, you’ll have fun reminiscing along the way! Best part? It’s completely FREE and ad-free—no interruptions, just a clean experience. 

Sure, there are other apps that help you delete photos fast, but honestly? They didn’t cut it for us. We wanted something simple, fun, and easy to use. UPic lets you go month-by-month through your photos, screenshots, and more, deciding what stays and what goes.

Here’s the deal:     
•    Swipe right to keep a photo     
•    Swipe left to delete it     
•    Messed up? No worries—just tap to go back!     
•    Review what you deleted, make tweaks, and boom—you’re done!

Don’t miss our On This Day feature—it pops up on your home screen with throwback pics from the same date a year or more ago. Swipe through those too!

Bonus features:     
•    Instantly add any photo to your favorites     
•    Share your photo stats with friends!
•    Wanna play photo roulette? Go thru your photos at random!
•    Stats that show how many pics you’ve deleted, memory saved, and more.

We’re always adding cool stuff! Your camera roll shouldn’t be full of blurry dupes and random screenshots. UPic helps you enjoy the memories without the clutter, totally FREE. 
Happy swiping! (And feel free to hit us up with feedback, ideas, or just to say hi at mpsteele553@gmail.com)
